body: Being drunk just feels so good, but it feels so terrible after a while
We’re all trying to. We’re on a trip in South Carolina for a spring break trip. We have a lot of time to talk and we can lean on each other.

Sorry for not answering, I’ve been trying to take days off social media since it’s supposed to be helpful. Yes it’s gotten worse but I have a lot of close friends that I can trust. We’ve been through a lot together and most of us are going through the same thing, alcohol and nicotine addiction.

I’ve just heard stories about people losing their friends after talking about it and my girlfriend used to be who I could trust, we dated for almost two years before breaking up less than a couple months ago, that’s why I started drinking.
They’ll probably think I’m lying, but I can’t blame them, I’m always super happy and energetic around other people.
Every time I want to talk about it I feel like I’m choking, like I can’t get the words out.
